Sample Input and Output pSI Data Sets

Source: R/sample.data.R
sample.data.Rd

A sample expression matrix and the corresponding specificity index (pSI) output, used to illustrate the pSI package functions.

Usage

sample.data

Format

A list of two data frames, each with 16866 rows (genes, as row names) and 6 columns (brain regions):

pSI.input

expression values

pSI.output

pSI values, NA where the gene is not specific to that region

Source

BrainSpan: Atlas of the Developing Human Brain, https://www.brainspan.org

Details

pSI.input is the BrainSpan RNA-seq data for young adulthood, condensed into six major regional divisions (one column per region). pSI.output is the pSI table calculated from it with specificity.index.

Examples

data(sample.data)
str(sample.data, max.level = 1)
#> List of 2
#>  $ pSI.input :'data.frame':	16866 obs. of  6 variables:
#>  $ pSI.output:'data.frame':	16866 obs. of  6 variables:
